examples.arabic: بابا اشترى خبز سخن ولبن للبيت.
examples.english: Dad bought hot bread and milk for the house.
examples.transliteration: Baba eshtara khobz sokhn we laban lel beit.

examples.arabic: شربنا شاي سخن وأكلنا شوية حلويات مع جيراننا.
examples.english: We drank hot tea and ate some sweets with our neighbors.
examples.transliteration: Sherebna shay sokhn wa akalna shwayet halawiyat ma'a geranna.

examples.arabic: هو سأل ليه الشاي سخن وليه بابا بيشتغل كتير كل يوم
examples.english: He asked why the tea is hot and why dad works a lot every day
examples.transliteration: Howa sa-al leh el shay sokhn we leh baba biyeshtaghal kteer kol yom
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.arabic: شربنا شاي سخن واكلنا حاجة حلوة
examples.english: We drank hot tea and ate a sweet thing.
examples.transliteration: sherebna shay sokhn we akalna haga helwa

examples.arabic: انا بشرب شاي سخن على المكتب
examples.english: I drink hot tea at the desk.
examples.transliteration: ana bashrab shay sokhn aala el maktab

examples.arabic: عمر بياكل الفول السخن وبيشرب شاي.
examples.english: Omar eats the hot ful and drinks tea.
examples.transliteration: Omar biyaakol el ful el sokhn wa biyeshrab shay.
